description: Suggest personalized binary-code gifts for programmers, engineers, couples or new parents. Give a date or a short text and get each product with a link that pre-fills the code. Use when the user asks for gift ideas for a techie, a geek, an anniversary or a baby.

date.description: Optional date to encode, YYYY-MM-DD (birthday, wedding, baby's birth date)

text.description: Optional name or short message to encode, up to 16 characters

name: suggest_binary_gifts
